title: Music Player-DiscDeck
description: Listen to music, manage playlists, and control playback without leaving Minecraft.
body:
Listen to music, manage playlists, and control playback without leaving Minecraft.
DiscDeck is a client-side Fabric music player with a custom Minecraft-inspired
interface. Open it from the music-disc button beside your inventory, add
playlists, search for tracks, and control playback directly in game.
Features
Play YouTube tracks, playlists, livestreams, direct URLs, and local files.
Manage playlists from a custom in-game interface.
Open DiscDeck from a button attached to the inventory UI.
Inventory button follows the inventory when the recipe book opens or closes.
Rotating pixel-art music disc now-playing overlay.
Play, pause, skip, repeat, shuffle, seek, and volume controls.
Compact track title, author, duration, and progress display.
Minecraft-inspired cyan and violet interface with blurred music artwork.
Configurable in-game overlay position and visibility.
Supported Versions
Download the JAR matching your exact Minecraft version:
1.20
1.20.1
1.20.2
1.20.4
1.20.6
1.21
1.21.1
Minecraft 1.20.3, 1.20.5, and versions newer than 1.21.1 are not currently
supported.
Required Dependencies
Fabric Loader
Fabric API for your Minecraft version
U Team Core for your Minecraft version
Mod Menu is optional.
Installation
Install Fabric Loader for your Minecraft version.
Install the matching Fabric API and U Team Core versions.
Place the matching DiscDeck JAR in your mods folder.
Open Minecraft and use the music-disc button beside the inventory.
Notes
DiscDeck is client-side and can be used on multiplayer servers.
Online music loading requires an internet connection.
Some services or individual tracks may be unavailable because of regional,
account, or provider restrictions.
